Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: document frame for the guided-install page of a project of the Olympuz family
Primary request: one wide calm frame for the page where the install happens as a conversation: two marble seats facing each other across a low table, one question at a time.
Input images: Image 1 is the immutable Pantheon style reference; Image 2 is the required family-signature column.
Subject: two plain marble stools face each other across a low marble table on a plain ivory floor. On the table lie six small identical marble tiles in a single row, and one muted-gold band rests across the first tile only, as if the conversation has reached its first question. No people. A classical white-marble column stands to the right as the family signature.
Composition/framing: 16:9 landscape, table and stools centred, generous empty ivory space, nothing cropped.
Style/medium: premium restrained 3D marble render, monumental carving with real weight, physically plausible materials, warm ivory Apple-like presentation
Lighting/mood: soft daylight from upper left, long gentle shadows, calm and welcoming. Gold glows softly FROM WITHIN, never lit by a lamp or a hard rim light.
Color palette: ivory #F3EFE8, bright ivory #FBFAF6, white marble, muted gold #C9A87A for bands and rims only, sky blue #B8D6EA for the ground threads only, charcoal #3E3A36
Constraints:
- Everything rests on the ground and casts its own shadow. Nothing hovers.
- The small figures are plain and identical, without faces and without attributes.
- Preserve the reference style of Image 1 exactly; highest final quality; maximum resolution.
Avoid: any deity with a helmet, owl, shield or spear, rainbow of many colors, flames, smoke, screens, keyboards, charts, bar graphs, pie charts, cables, brand marks, dark background, black background, neon, purple gradient, smoky cinema lighting, heavy bronze, metallic or plastic marble, watermark, callout labels
Text (verbatim): No readable text, no letters, no digits anywhere in the image.
